title: Nantucket Travel Poster
coreRelationships: The prominent brick building acts as the central architectural anchor, defining the historical character of the scene.
The cobblestone street and water with sailboats provide environmental context, suggesting a coastal, old-world setting.
The strong diagonal lines of the building and street guide the eye from the upper left to the lower right, creating depth.
The large, bold text at the bottom firmly grounds the promotional message within the visual narrative.
The interplay of light and shadow emphasizes texture and form, particularly on the cobblestones and building facade.
reuseFormula: Recreate a high-angle, illustrative scene of a historical coastal town. Feature a prominent, multi-story brick building with a distinct roof, situated on a textured cobblestone street. Include a body of water with small, colorful sailboats in the background. Employ strong directional lighting to create deep shadows and bright highlights, enhancing texture and depth. Use a warm, earthy color palette with contrasting blues/greens and limited, vibrant accents. Integrate large, bold, vintage-style typography for the location and a smaller, complementary font for the sponsor at the bottom, framed by the illustration.
